claim: Blocking horizontal uptake raises first-replicator origination in two NEW substrates (S_LOCAL 28 vs 16, p 0.021; S_PAIR320 98 vs 71, p 0.006; 400 paired worlds each)
status: CAUSALLY_CONFIRMED (intervention, paired, preregistered direction from BEL-48H; new substrates)

claim: The functional loss/gain ratio of uptake events predicts the direction of the uptake-block effect
status: FALSIFIED (D1-P1: S_LOCAL R 0.674 predicted NO_INCREASE, observed INCREASE)

claim: Copy-length coupling of computation to reproduction has two separable components: budget exhaustion (input read before copy; vanishes at budget >= 384) and I/O damage (input read after copy; budget-independent to 4,096); compute-first machines are immune to both
status: CAUSALLY_CONFIRMED on 4 specimens (deterministic intervention grid; 1 evolved, 3 synthetic); prevalence of each type in evolved populations NOT measured
